name: process-tests-linux

engine.version: lab test build of the integration head (scripts/ops_dev.sh, REXL3_COMMIT=lab-rexl3-inkling2-loop); pinned_commit is the same commit

commands: NODE=<node-4> LAB_SRC=<engine worktree at the pinned commit> PKG=gb-server OPS_LINES=200 scripts/ops_dev.sh test process ""
notes: The whole `process` test binary of gb-server (signals, drain, watchdogs, exit codes, the malloc-arena re-exec) on Linux at the pinned engine commit, node-4 idle, GPU SM clock capped at 2,200 MHz (the cap's success line printed before the build and before the run: raw/process-linux.log). On macOS the test `the_server_caps_its_malloc_arenas_unless_the_caller_named_a_value_or_opted_out` fails at crates/server/tests/process.rs:425 because it reads /proc/<pid>/environ; no server, GPU or pack is involved in these tests. An earlier run at 4f939a6 on node-2 gave the same 14 of 14 after ops_dev.sh was fixed to run the test-profile executable instead of the server binary built as a dependency.
